questions.text: Look around!
paras: Right now, you’re surrounded by some of the most interesting and talented people you’ll ever meet—future innovators, leaders, and yes, maybe your future life partner.
But let’s be honest—time flies. Before you know it, garba will be over, graduation will hit and everyone will head off on their own paths.
That’s where Garba Finder comes in.
Think of us as your ultimate matchmaking wingperson, powered by science, ML and algorithms.

Answer our carefully crafted questionnaire, and we’ll use research-backed matching techniques to match you with someone who actually gets you. Whether it’s for an unforgettable garba night… or something that lasts way beyond it.

I am not gonna sell your data. I am probably not even gonna look at it. Once we close the form, I will just export the csv from Supabase which will be then put into the matchmaking backend which will return csv of matches which will go to a SMTP server (hosted on my computer) and you'll all get the mail.
And then I will delete all data.
You can see the code for yourself here: https://github.com/TheArjunAgarwal/open-pact
